mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 7.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% combined with a decline in average hourly earnings (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 7.5% and HOUST declines
regime_hint: labor market weakening with falling wages
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 7.5% and HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 98.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with a decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 7.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
